Privacy.title: Privacy policy
Privacy.intro: This page explains what data we collect when you use the Ortho'Care Clinic website, why we collect it, and your rights.

what.title: What we collect
what.body:
When you book online, we collect your first name, last name and phone number, and, if you provide them, your email address and date of birth. We also store your appointment details (service, date, time) and your consent.
We do not collect any payment data on this site.

why.title: Why we collect this data
why.body: This information is used solely to manage your appointments: create them, contact you to confirm, send reminders and follow up on your care.

processors.title: Our providers
processors.body: Your data is hosted and processed by providers located outside Algeria: our host (Vercel), our database (hosted PostgreSQL), our messaging service (SMS/WhatsApp) and our error-monitoring tool (Sentry). Google reviews and the map are embedded via Google widgets.

retention.title: How long we keep data
retention.body: We keep your appointment and patient data as long as needed for your follow-up, then in line with our legal obligations.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You can ask at any time to correct or delete your data by contacting the clinic. You can also opt out of non-essential messages (SMS/WhatsApp) by letting us know.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: For any question about your data, contact us at +213 793 03 58 93 or at the clinic: 10, rue Larbi Abdelsalem, Rouiba, Algiers.
